4885327085615.descriptionHtml:
The BodyJ4You 12PC Tattoo Choker Necklace Set is a pack of 12 stretchy 90s-style tattoo chokers in a henna-style weave that slip on over the head with no clasp, made of soft non-toxic plastic and stretching up to 18 inches (45 cm).

Key Facts

  • Product type: Stretch tattoo choker necklace set
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Count: 12 chokers per pack
  • Material: Soft, flexible, non-toxic, odor-free plastic
  • Fit: Stretches up to 18 inches (45 cm); size listed as adjustable
  • Closure: None, slips on over the head
  • Water use: Waterproof for beach, pool and gym wear
  • Colors available: 10 color options, from solid black to pastel and mixed packs

What's Included

  • 12 stretch tattoo choker necklaces in the selected color option

Variants

  • Black: black gothic and emo look
  • Multicolor: pink, blue and green mix
  • Rainbow: rainbow colorful mix
  • Black, Clear: black and white goth mix
  • Black, Red: black and red gothic mix
  • Pink, Clear: pink and white pastel mix
  • Aqua, Pink, Clear: pink, blue and white mix
  • Black, Pink, Clear: black, pink and white mix
  • Summer Mix: colorful beaded mix
  • Gothic Black: black velvet lace look

Features

  • Classic henna-style tattoo weave from 90s and Y2K fashion
  • Elastic band sits close to the neck with no clasp
  • Light enough to forget you are wearing it
  • Waterproof, so it can stay on at the pool, beach or gym
  • Wear one alone or stack two or three colors for a layered 2000s look
  • Layers with BodyJ4You charms

How to Use

Stretch the choker gently open, slip it over your head and let it settle at the base of the neck. Expect a snug fit that relaxes slightly after a few wears.

Use Cases

  • 90s or Y2K outfits and 2000s fashion
  • Goth, emo, grunge, scene, alt and punk style
  • Halloween costume accessory for witch, vampire, goth or 90s costumes
  • Concerts, raves, music festivals and pride parades
  • 90s theme parties and party favors
  • Pairing with a little black dress

Care and Safety

Made from non-toxic, odor-free plastic and waterproof. Stretch gently rather than pulling hard.

Frequently Asked Questions

What size are the BodyJ4You 12PC tattoo chokers?

Each BodyJ4You 12PC tattoo choker is a stretch band that expands up to 18 inches (45 cm) and is listed as adjustable. It fits snug at first and relaxes slightly after a few wears.

How many chokers come in the pack?

The BodyJ4You 12PC Tattoo Choker Necklace Set contains 12 stretch chokers in the color option you choose.

What are the chokers made of?

The chokers are made of soft, flexible, non-toxic and odor-free plastic. There is no metal and no clasp.

Can I wear these chokers in water?

Yes. The BodyJ4You 12PC tattoo chokers are waterproof for beach, pool and gym wear.

Do they work for a Halloween costume?

Yes. The black tattoo chokers are listed as a Halloween accessory for witch, vampire, goth and 90s costumes.

Which color option should I choose?

Choose Black or Gothic Black for a goth or emo look, Pink, Clear or Aqua, Pink, Clear for pastels, and Rainbow, Multicolor or Summer Mix for festival and rave outfits.

How does this compare with the 24PC set?

The BodyJ4You 12PC set has 12 chokers per pack; BodyJ4You also sells a 24PC tattoo choker set with 24 chokers per pack.

The BodyJ4You 2PC Tattoo Choker Leather Necklace Set pairs one stretchable 90s tattoo choker with one black choker in your chosen style (heart, short spikes, long spikes or half moon), made with skin-friendly, nickel-free materials for goth, punk and Y2K looks.

  • Pieces: 2 chokers: 1 stretch tattoo choker plus 1 style choker

  • Metal accents: Silver-tone heart ring or spikes; gold-tone moon pendant

  • 1 stretchable tattoo choker

  • Black Heart: black leather heart choker with a silver-tone heart ring and snap button closure for an adjustable fit
  • Short Spikes: black leather choker with short silver-tone spikes and an adjustable buckle
  • Long Spikes: black leather choker with long silver-tone spikes and an adjustable buckle

  • Tattoo choker echoes the henna-tattoo look of 90s fashion
  • Stretchable tattoo choker gives a secure, flexible fit

What comes in the BodyJ4You 2PC Tattoo Choker Leather Set?

Each set includes 2 chokers: one stretchable tattoo choker and one black choker in the style you pick (Black Heart, Short Spikes, Long Spikes or Half Moon).

How do the chokers fasten?

The tattoo choker stretches on. The Black Heart choker uses a snap button, the Short and Long Spikes chokers use an adjustable buckle, and the Half Moon choker uses a lobster clasp with an extender chain.

What is the difference between Short Spikes and Long Spikes?

Both are black leather chokers with silver-tone spikes and an adjustable buckle; the Short Spikes style has shorter spikes and the Long Spikes style has longer ones.

Is the set nickel free?

Yes. The BodyJ4You 2PC leather choker set is made with skin-friendly materials with no nickel and is listed as hypoallergenic.

Is this set good for a Halloween costume?

Yes. The BodyJ4You 2PC tattoo choker leather set is listed for Halloween costumes and gothic-themed parties as well as everyday goth and punk outfits.

Which style is the most subtle?

The Half Moon set has a thin black braided choker with a small gold-tone crescent moon pendant, a lighter look than the spiked styles.
